text: Therefore, in the first part of this article, we argue against eliminativism, and in favor of an emergentist approach which, while on the one hand considers the brain as the foundation of the mind and the mind as an expression of brain activity, on the other hand believes it necessary to adopt a multilayer, complex, self – emergent view of reality, that allows to give mental concepts the right role in the explanation of psychopathology.
source_label: Unhealthy mind in a healthy body: A criticism to eliminativism in psychopathology
